study_identification_part.si4_title: GPT- based normative models of brain sMRI correlate with dimensional psychopathology

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Evaluate whether GPT-based generative normative models trained on youth sMRI can capture dimensional psychopathology and clinical diagnoses by relating model-derived typicality likelihoods to CBCL symptom scales, ADHD scores, and ASD diagnosis.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Pearson correlations between per-ROI likelihoods and CBCL/ADHD scores with Bonferroni correction; For ASD, region-wise and whole-brain AUC with permutation p-values (1,000 permutations) and Bonferroni correction.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Whole-brain typicality correlated with social problems (ABCD test) and with ASD diagnosis (ABIDE-II); ROI-level likelihoods associated with multiple CBCL scales and ADHD scores.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: In ABCD test set (n=3,524), whole-brain typicality likelihood correlated with CBCL social problems (Bonferroni-corrected p=0.006). In ABIDE-II (n=580), whole-brain AUC for ASD diagnosis was 0.60 with p<0.001; multiple ROIs showed significant AUCs (e.g., ParaHippocampal_L AUC=0.627, Postcentral_R AUC=0.626). In ADHD-200 (n=922), several ROIs correlated with inattentive and hyperactive/impulsive scores (e.g., Substantia nigra pars compacta (R) r=-0.248 with hyperactive/impulsive, r=-0.228 with inattentive; Cerebellum_Crus2_L r=-0.263 with hyperactive/impulsive).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Nine-model GPT ensemble trained on VQ-VAE tokens from VBM GM/WM; AAL3 ROI mapping for interpretability; Bonferroni correction and permutation testing for significance.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: This article does not report imaging QC metrics or site/scanner harmonization; the normative model does not account for covariates such as site/age/sex; group-level demographic breakdowns are not provided.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Only baseline scans were used. ABCD was split by CBCL quartiles to ensure normative training on lower three quartiles; all high-CBCL subjects were placed in the test set. Data span many sites and scanner types (ABCD: 21 sites; ADHD-200: 8 sites; ABIDE-II: 19 sites; BHRCS: 1.5T GE scanners).
